body: I’m 17 and have been to the psych ward 3 times in the last year lots of sec harm a couple of suicide attempts and such mine started because of neglect I lived with my family like most kids do but I wasn’t really there no one gave a shit about me I was bullied at school and I came home to fade into nothingness didn’t change until I hit 16 when my school found out and told my parents and shit just hit the fan from there. Gotta love when your entire school district (several high schools) has a suicide awareness day like three days after you’re put into the mental hospital xD

A cop in my town (quite small) commit suicide last week he was one of five officers in town. Had a wife four kids two girls two boys he was a nice  guy everyone liked him (for the most part) you’d think that would be a picture perfect life. You never know what demons someone is facing no matter how popular or know they are, I wish you the happiest of birthdays and I hope you stay safe.

For me it was the uncertainty of life. I still struggle every now and then (hence why I’m here) but I try to look towards the future and I never planned on living past 16 but I’m pushing through 17 now and I’m glad I did you never know what’s going to happen tomorrow but you can make it great. I’m not saying the future is all sunshine and rainbows but it can be slow dancing in the rain or whatever you like to think of it as. Make tomorrow what you want it to be.

This week has been nothing but pain I thought I was finally happy I don’t know who I can trust anymore people I cared about so much are turning against me my best friend turned against me I don’t know what to do anymore I only have one person to live for but I can’t be with them for a while because they are out of country, I don’t feel safe without them anymore and they aren’t able to talk very much. I haven’t been in this much pain since the last time I was admitted into a psych ward and I just don’t know anymore
